senses.gloss:
Loud,Ⓒa.Ⓓucca, tAra, mahat, guru, uttAla; mahAsvana, gurusvara, mahADvanikara (rI f.), mahA-bahu-Goza, mahASabda, GozaRa; ‘a l(oud) noise’ tArasvaraH, uccErGozaH, mahASabdaH-svanaH, praRAdaH tumularavaH.
Ⓝ[Loud]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹuccEH, tAra-ucca-svareRa, proccEH, mahASabdena, mahAsvanena; ‘still l(oud)er’ uccEstarAM.
Ⓝ[Loud]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹuccatA, ma-hattvaM, uttAlatA, &c.

Lounge,Ⓒv. i.ⒹudAs 2 A, Alasyena kAlaM kzip 6 P or hf 1 P, alasIBU.
Ⓝ[Loung]er,Ⓒs.Ⓓala-sajanaH, kAlakzepakaH, udAsInaH, kAryapuwaH.
Ⓝ[Loung]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓalasa, maMda; See Lazy; ‘l(ounging) gait’ matteBagati f. gamanaM.

Louse,Ⓒs.ⒹyUkaH-kA, keSakIwaH; ‘l(ouse)-egg’ likzA.
Ⓝ[Lous]y,Ⓒa.ⒹbahuyUka, yUkApUrRa, yUkopadruta, sayUka.

Lout,Ⓒs.ⒹgrAmyajanaH, vfzalaH, grAmIRaH, sTUla-janaH.
Ⓝ[Lout]ish,Ⓒa.ⒹgrAmya, sTUla, aSizwa, asaBya; sTUla-budDi-mati.
